E2104

`{problem}`

What

`{problem}`

Why

Jet needs valid command input before it can run this command.

Fix

Correct the named argument or input, then run the command again.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2104: tests/ui/inspect_target_live_scope_e2104.stderr.

Error [jet.InvalidCommandInput]: `jet inspect target` reads no live process or replay
 Why: Jet needs valid command input before it can run this command
 Fix: Run `jet inspect target <machine>` with one of board.sensor_v1, board.virt_aarch64, wasm.browser, wasm.wasi, wasm.no-os, hosted
